pkg.lyricsBlock:
[Intro]
(gayageum scraped spark, distant jing, taepyeongso short threat, first 8 seconds)
Should I jump like crazy
Are you ready

[Verse 1]
(ajaeng torn-low tone, gayageum tight rhythm, janggu war-walk)
매일 아침 눈 뜨면 전쟁
가슴은 이미 만신창이
웃는 얼굴 뒤에 숨긴 상처들
이제 더는 못 참아, 터뜨려
빌딩 숲 속에 갇힌 나를 꺼내
가면 벗어던지고 진짜 얼굴 꺼내
오늘은 내가 룰을 정해
Fuck your rules, 이 밤은 내 거야

[Pre-Chorus]
(buk entering, female count, rising bass)
하나, 둘, 셋, 숨을 죽여
넷, 다섯, 여섯, 불을 지펴
일곱, 여덟, 아홉
지금이야, 터뜨려

[BUILD]
(taepyeongso rising screams, janggu rolls, explosive kkwaenggwari, bass choke)
Listen up
It’s DIFFICULT
It’s DIRTY
It’s DANGEROUS
It’s STRESS, but tonight
WE START THE GODDAMN BLAZESTORM

[DROP]
(0.5 sec kill then instant bass + buk/janggu slam, jing crack, taepyeongso lead in 0.3 sec)
BLAZESTORM, D-D-D-DROP IT
BLAZESTORM, D-D-D-FUCK IT
BLAZESTORM, D-D-D-BURN IT DOWN
BLAZESTORM

[Chorus]
(taepyeongso lead, punchy bass, female chant, male thick stack)
모든 게 터져도 좋아, 다 부숴도 괜찮아
심장 터질 때까지 뛰어
BLAZESTORM, D-D-D-DROP IT
BLAZESTORM, D-D-D-FUCK IT
스트레스, 재로 만들어 놔
오늘 밤은 우리가 미쳐
BLAZESTORM
Hey, Hey, Hey

[Verse 2]
(gayageum strike pattern, sogeum wind-cut, driving percussion)
JUMP, JUMP, JUMP, 더 높이
SCREAM, SCREAM, SCREAM, 터뜨려
이 모든 똥 같은 기분 다 날려버려
We are the BLAZESTORM tonight
Higher, Louder, Crazy, Wilder
원하지도 않은 무게는 내려놔
가짜 미소는 찢어버려라
피곤한 영혼에 불 붙여놔
이제야 알았어 내가 주인공이란 걸

[Rap Break]
(male aggressive low-register English rap, hard janggu/buk, kkwaenggwari hits)
Cliff edge, I still jump
Kill the dream then wake it up
This stage is mine, I wear the crown
Bow down, this is my kingdom now
You still breathing? Then it ain’t done
Last drop squeezed, we don’t run
Difficult, dirty, dangerous night
We light the storm and own the fight

[BUILD 2]
(taepyeongso frantic riffs, double janggu, kkwaenggwari hail, bass swell)
너 아직도 숨 쉬고 있지
그럼 아직 안 끝났어
마지막 한 방울까지 짜내
THIS IS THE END OR THE BEGINNING
ONE MORE TIME
DIFFICULT, DIRTY, DANGEROUS
DISGUSTING, DEADLY, DEVASTATING
EVERYBODY SCREAM
UNLEASH THE FINAL BLAZESTORM

[DROP 2]
(instant bass + Korean percussion wrecking ball, jing resonance, taepyeongso peak)
BLAZESTORM, D-D-D-DROP IT
BLAZESTORM, D-D-D-FUCK IT
BLAZESTORM, D-D-D-BURN IT DOWN
BLAZESTORM, BLAZESTORM, BLAZESTORM

[Final Chorus]
(full riot ensemble, hook stacked)
모든 게 터져도 좋아, 다 부숴도 괜찮아
심장 터질 때까지 뛰어
BLAZESTORM, D-D-D-DROP IT
BLAZESTORM, D-D-D-FUCK IT
스트레스, 재로 만들어 놔
오늘 밤은 우리가 미쳐
BLAZESTORM
불타는 도시 위로 날아올라
BLAZESTORM, Burn
BLAZESTORM, Burn
이 밤을 영원히 기억해
BLAZESTORM

[Outro]
(jing long burn, ajaeng last snarl, gayageum ember fade)
DDD
DDD
BLAZESTORM
We are eternal
pkg.sunoStyle:
Korean traditional fusion EDM with afrobeat groove.
Instruments: gayageum, ajaeng, taepyeongso, sogeum, janggu, buk, kkwaenggwari, jing.
Bass: deep sub bass, strong, punchy, clean from kick.
Drums: afrobeat groove + Korean traditional rhythm.
Drop: instant hit after build, bass + Korean percussion dominate. Taepyeongso or ajaeng lead within 0.3 sec. Kkwaenggwari for tension only, jing for resonance.
Vocal: female bright and emotional. male deep, thick, heavy and resonant.
Male rap: aggressive, rhythmic, low-register English rap.
Structure: build → drop → chorus. 100-110 BPM.
Atmosphere: traditional + modern + cinematic Joseon night vibe.
Restrictions: no modern synth lead, no weak bass, no thin vocal, traditional instruments must remain clearly recognizable.
